inputs.text: The government in Uttar Pradesh has failed to set up any clear process for brick kiln operators to get environmental clearances three months after the mandate, leaving industry stakeholders stuck in confusion and facing unnecessary criticism. These operators already hold proper approvals from the State Pollution Control Board on water and air quality, and they stand ready to handle the extra requirements if the state simply streamlines things and removes middlemen interference. Legal experts keep pushing for strict compliance with recent court decisions, yet the real need is for authorities to step in with firm leadership and establish a practical framework. This regulatory tangle only hurts traditional local industries that sustain families, uphold social order, and contribute to our national strength.
